data.name: Triple Run
data.detailed_description:
Join us on Discord

Click the Discord link in the section to the left.


About the Game

Three runners. One course. One total time.

Triple Run is a third-person time-attack platformer where every millisecond counts. Each course is completed by three unique runners, and your final score is the combined time of all three runs.

Watch out for mistakes, because each one carries over to your final time. And when a mistake costs you too many seconds, simply restart your run in an instant and try again. No loading screens. No waiting. Just pure action!

BECOME THE CHAMPION

Begin your journey with local Triple Run underground races and aim for the Ultimate Galactic Tournament — the top entertainment event in our dystopian future.

Once you become the champion, there will be plans for you — plans you didn't see coming...

ADVANCE THROUGH TOURNAMENTS

Set faster times to unlock new tournament tiers and race across increasingly dangerous locations throughout multiple star systems.

EXPAND YOUR CREW

Recruit runners with unique strengths, unlock powerful abilities, discover hidden loot, and level up. Runners come from diverse factions, each with their own set of skills and personal goals. Choose wisely. Building the perfect crew for each course doesn't come easy.

EASY TO START, HARD TO MASTER

Triple Run is tailored for both casual and hardcore players. The rules are simple, but achieving the perfect run time is a real challenge. Every retry is a chance to go faster.

BUILT FOR MASTERY

Chase cleaner lines, discover hidden shortcuts, and refine execution across all three runs. With smooth, momentum-driven movement, even the smallest optimizations can bring big gains.

COMPETE & IMPROVE

Climb the leaderboards and compete against your friends or the entire world. Your best time is only temporary. 

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Most time-attack running games test a single run. With car racing DNA, Triple Run tests consistency under pressure.

You need to perform - again and again and again.

SHARE YOUR BEST AND WORST MOMENTS

Clutch finishes and last-second saves? Clean runs vs. total collapses? Either way, they're perfect for clips, streams, and competition. 

Wishlist and follow Triple Run today. Your perfect run is waiting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Corei3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD HD 7970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
